statements.label: Theorem 1 (whole)
statements.restatement: For all x in X and pi* in T with P c(x) >= 0 and (P c(x))_pi = 0 for pi in T = {1,5,6,9,14,18} (= paper T_90 literally; extra contacts allowed): Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 for all O in SO(4). No restriction on spectra (the argument works on X directly; 'spectrally realizable' = x in X via paper Sect. 3).

statements.label: Lemma 2
statements.restatement: Through every strict point (off-T gaps > 0, real d > 0, E = F5 - F1 = 1) there is an irreducible algebraic curve in X keeping the five complex differences F_i - F_1 (i in T) fixed, on which some anchored coordinate is nonconstant.

statements.label: Lemma 3
statements.restatement: If 2(d+r)b = ra - d^2 + L0 d + B0 with real r, L0, B0, Im d = y != 0 and Im a/y, Im b/y bounded, then |b| <= C(1+|d|), |ra| <= C(1+|d|^2); if also f+g+d = (-(r-u+1)ra + P2(d))/(2(d+Af)(d+Ag)), deg P2 <= 2, then f+g+d is bounded as |d| -> infinity.
